thread:
Kai: Morning async — quick standup for aurora-7b-q onboarding.
What I did: finished model import + quantization pass, ran the smoke eval suite against the latest promptset (semantic-search + qa-synth). Pushed canary spec to staging.

Jess: Nice. Any obvious deltas in the eval numbers?

Kai: Yep, small regression on QA accuracy vs baseline. Summary from the runner:
```
rd-eval run --model aurora-7b-q --promptset qa-synth --runs 3
EM: 0.71 -> 0.66
F1: 0.78 -> 0.74
avg_latency: 217ms (prev 200ms)
```
Also saw a handful of hallucination tokens in the long-context tests.

Alex: Hmm. Did you enable the aggressive quant config (q4_0-fast) or the safer q4_1-balanced?

Kai: Used q4_0-fast to hit latency targets for Dedicated tests. suspect quant is the main suspect.

Dina: Can you paste the promptset diff? I want to check if a new instruction elevated the hallucination rate.

Kai: Pushed the promptset diff at https://git.redwood/infra/promptsets/aurora/compare/refs/123..refs/124 and linked the failing cases in the eval run. Also filed infra issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/2345 — it's tagged `onboard` + `regression`.

Jess: I'll take the CR for the quant config change. If rollback to q4_1 removes the regression we can add a perf experiment flag.

Sam: deploy-bot reports the canary rollout hit a degraded-health alert: "canary-aurora-7b-q: 3/5 pods unhealthy" — autoscaler didn't kick because reserved capacity is capped in staging.

deploy-bot: [notification] Canary rollout paused at 03:14 UTC. See dashboard: https://console.redwood/rollouts/aurora-7b-q/canary

Alex: Two quick asks: 1) try a KV-cache warmup before the evals, we saw cold-cache latency spikes; 2) run the evals with prefix-caching toggled off to isolate.

Kai: Will run these: (1) rollback quant to q4_1, (2) re-run evals with/without prefix cache, (3) re-run with warmup script. I'll post output later today. Blocking: need someone to approve the CR that toggles the canary resource limits (low priority but helps autoscaler). @Jess can you review today?

Jess: On it, pinged in the PR with a couple comments. Expect review by EOD. :+1:

Dina: If the rollback fixes the QA regression, we should add a promptset-level regression test to catch this automatically next onboarding.

Kai: Agree — will create a follow-up ticket to add the promptset gate and include the failing cases as smoke checks.

Sam: FYI ops is available if you want an emergency increase in staging cap to finish the canary. Ping me with the slack thread.

Kai: Thanks all — next update in this thread once I have the re-run. tl;dr: suspect quant -> rolling rollback + cache experiments. Actions: Kai runs experiments, Jess reviews CR, Dina drafts promptset gate, Sam on-call if capacity needed. :eyes:
